purpose: Global benchmark registry comparing Deen Allah Encyclopedia capability coverage against major Islamic digital resources and research libraries.
method: Compare capabilities, not authority; an external platform is evidence of a feature, not evidence of religious truth.

priorityGaps.description: Unified query -> specialist fan-out -> evidence table -> citations -> conflicts -> drill-down experience.
Match leading Quran study UX: audio, translations, tafsir switching, word-level navigation, bookmarks/notes, progress and accessible mobile presentation.
Provide broad tafsir coverage with parallel comparison, commentator metadata, Quran-science linking and precise verse-level navigation.
Expose author/book/series/century/keyword facets and downloadable/readable editions where rights permit.
Canonical work identity + edition identity + origin clustering so mirrors/translations/copies do not inflate independence.
Store query, source set, retrieval timestamp, ranking inputs, evidence links, and uncertainty state for reproducible research.
Cross-link books, authors, statements, verses, hadith, citations, editions and derived claims as a navigable graph.
Synchronize text, audio, video, page images, timestamps and speaker attribution with provenance.
Bookmarks, notes, reading lists, study goals and saved searches without changing authoritative corpus.
Keyboard/screen-reader/mobile support, RTL correctness, multilingual search and language-aware UI/voice.
Continuous retrieval/evidence benchmarks for Arabic queries, source precision, recall, citation accuracy and contradiction handling.

nonGoals: declare a competitor wrong merely because it lacks our controls
replace the trusted Corpus with benchmark discoveries
